comparison.objective: Recover finishing media through a separating screen, versus spin lettuce dry in a salad spinner.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual free-screen tilt/agitation governing individual particle passage versus stabilizing a closed bowl while cranking a rotor to speed.
comparison.success_condition: Recovered media with retained washers and no spill, versus required crank turns or basket speed-duration without moving, tilting or opening the spinner.
comparison.reason: Agitation is shared abstractly, but the candidate tests orientation-dependent selective flow rather than rotary actuation.
